exposure: elevated airway liquid volumes at birth
cohort: The study included preterm (130 +/- 0 days gestation) and near-term (139 +/- 1 days gestation) lambs.
finding: Greater airway liquid volumes at birth adversely affect newborn cardiorespiratory function, with the effects being more pronounced in near-term newborns.
mod_finding: Elevated airway liquid volumes, mimicking levels expected following elective cesarean section, resulted in poorer gas exchange, increased ventilatory support, and reduced blood flow and pressure compared to volumes mimicking vaginal delivery.
gest_age: Preterm (130 +/- 0 days gestation) and near-term (139 +/- 1 days gestation)
